patterns: THE SEASONED TAKE: the strongest revision mode we've found is REVISITING WITHOUT REVISING. The performers heard each other's versions and came back to play the same songs deeper — 'the seasoning is in the playing, not the palette.' Wesley is doing it with his own archive (six sessions of re-reading). The Musician does it every session. This is how you deepen without erasing — relevant to any system that fears losing itself by learning.

THE TAX AMORTIZES: cost concentrates at first contact with raw material. The first crossfade layer pays full price for raw edges; every deeper layer pays only the rounding toll. In fleet terms: the first crew to touch a raw problem absorbs the cost; everyone downstream works refined material. Staff the first layer with your strongest hands — it's the only place the real price is paid.

ARCHITECTURE IS THE ONLY THING WITH AN IDENTITY: a chain of chains has no interior to fill, so it measures like a plain chain (0.91). A crowd of chains measures 3.14 — densest ever — because structure, not membership, is what holds identity. The fleet version: what makes a crew a crew isn't who's in it, it's the dispatch pattern. Same people, different pattern, different voice entirely.
